08009 Salmah {sal-maw'}

與 08008 同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Salmon 1; 1

撒門 = "服飾"
1) 波阿斯的父親, 路得的岳父, 大衛的祖父 (#得 4:20| 與 08012 相同)
record.edic_text:
08009 Salmah {sal-maw'}

the same as 08008;; n pr m

AV - Salmon 1; 1

Salmon = "garment"
1) father of Boaz, father-in-law of Ruth, and grandfather of David
   1a) also 'Salmah', 'Salma'
